behavior_constraints: Flag absent or accepted: summary.time_range in --output is byte-identical to existing accepted-only behavior (min/max over accepted events; null/null when zero accepted).
Empty value (--summary-time-range-policy= or "") => exit 2, no output files created, exact stderr: 'ingest: --summary-time-range-policy: value must be non-empty'.
Value not in {accepted, observed, strict-observed} => exit 2, no output files created, exact stderr: 'ingest: --summary-time-range-policy: value must be one of accepted|observed|strict-observed'.
Empty-value check runs at parse time; enumeration check runs immediately after; both before any .tmp or output file is written.

observed: time_range.min/max recomputed over every input line that parses as a JSON object AND has a ts matching exact RFC3339 UTC form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, regardless of audit bucket; null/null when no contributing lines.
observed corpus equals union of sharding-report shards[i].first_ts/last_ts contributions; invariants hold when --sharding-report also emitted.
strict-observed: runs full accepted pipeline (byte-identical to accepted), then computes observed; if accepted and observed ranges coincide (string-equal including null/null) exit 0.

strict-observed divergence => exit 2, all emitted output/sidecar/.tmp files removed (--output, --rejects, --state-out, --audit-log, --audit-log-digest, --out-parquet-manifest, --manifest-signature, --summary-schema-*, --sharding-report-*, --run-provenance-*), exact stderr: 'ingest: --summary-time-range-policy: strict-observed divergence: accepted=[<a_min>,<a_max>] observed=[<o_min>,<o_max>]' with literal 'null' for null endpoints.
Flag composes freely with all existing flags; NOT gated on --sharding-report/--summary-schema-out/--run-provenance.
Run-provenance flags object records the argv token verbatim (accepted|observed|strict-observed) under key 'summary-time-range-policy' in the fixed enumeration position.
affected_prior: round 11 sharding-report first_ts/last_ts corpus (observed must equal it)
round 12 run-provenance flags enumeration (new key summary-time-range-policy)
entities.summary: Add --summary-time-range-policy <accepted|observed|strict-observed> to control whether summary.time_range covers accepted events only, all RFC3339-UTC-timestamped JSON-parseable lines, or enforces equality of the two with cleanup-on-divergence.

instruction_head:
# Summary Time Range Policy

`summary.time_range` currently reflects accepted events only, while the
sharding report's `first_ts` and `last_ts` fields reflect every JSON-parseable
line with a conforming UTC timestamp, even if the event is later rejected. Add
`--summary-time-range-policy <accepted|observed|strict-observed>` so operators
can keep the accepted-only behavior, opt into the broader observed range, or
enforce that the accepted and observed ranges coincide.
